newsitem.title: FRANCE: Caisse d'Epargne in non-life insurance move - source.
newsitem.headline: Caisse d'Epargne in non-life insurance move - source.

text.p: The central board of French savings bank grouping Caisses d'Epargne is expected to agree a deal next Monday to move into non-life insurance with France's Mutuelles du Mans, an industry source said on Wednesday.
La Tribune daily newspaper said the deal was likely to cover multi-risk residential property insurance and car insurance and the source said the story was reliable.
A spokesman for the Caisses d'Epargne declined to comment when contacted by Reuters.
